name: Upright: Impossible Balance
summary: Upright: Impossible Balance is a one-finger balance game for mobile. The player is a street performer in a lantern-lit night market, balancing a growing bamboo pole on one fingertip by dragging anywhere on the screen. The pole gains a foot of height for every second it stays up and tips faster as it grows, while gusts of wind and landing sparrows push it off balance. Modes include Classic, a Daily Challenge with the same wind and birds for every player, Windy Night, Bird Festival, Paper Pole and Insane, which adds a pole in each hand. Coins tossed by the crowd unlock performers and painted poles, six legendary poles are earned only by height, and a moderated Hall of Fame holds one world record at a time. Every fall can be replayed in slow motion and shared as a clip.
